msg: Hello, I'm organizing a team activity for 12 colleagues from our company in Germany: 4 are certified divers and 8 have never dived. We'll need an invoice for the company. Is next Friday possible?
reply:
Yes, next Friday is a great option. We operate every day except December 25 and January 1, and the date and group size are selected in the booking link. For a next-day booking, the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; same-day bookings aren’t available. Trips may be suspended in adverse weather.

Certified divers and beginners can join the same tour: the certified divers can dive while the beginners do the mini-course. Since you’re booking for a company and need an invoice, that part is handled by a team member.

This needs to be checked by a person from our team, who can see bookings, payments and emails. I'm passing you to a Diving Planet advisor now and they'll get in touch with you shortly. Thanks! 🙌

msg: Before that, could you tell me the prices per person and whether there is a group discount for 12 people?
reply:
For 12 people, the group discount applies: an extra 10% on top of the 10% online discount, for a total 20% when booking online. It must be requested from the team before paying.

The price is the same in either currency; Colombians and residents of Colombia pay in COP, and other international guests pay in USD. The advisor already has your case and will write here.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: From Cartagena. OK, we'll wait for the advisor, thanks.
reply: Noted 🙌 I've already passed your case to an advisor from the team: they can see this whole conversation and will write to you here shortly.
